outcome: Breastfeeding at time of hospital discharge
cohort: 34,511 women with live, singleton pregnancies delivered in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, between April 2001 and March 2018
finding: Infants born at early term (37-38 weeks) were less likely to be breastfed at the time of hospital discharge compared to infants born at full term (39-41 weeks)
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to be a risk factor for not breastfeeding at the time of postpartum hospital discharge.
